title: Narrow the swallow-all catch in gamification_p1_test.dart's _loadMilestones test helper
why: _loadMilestones backs the final assertion of 4 tests (E2E-605/606/607/613) that all compare SharedPreferences-persisted reward milestones against expected titles. A bare `catch (_) { return const []; }` around the JSON decode+map turns ANY exception — a genuine RewardMilestone.fromJson schema-mismatch bug, JSON corruption, a typo in the config key — into a silently-returned empty list. A real production regression here would surface only as a confusing 'expected isNotEmpty, got []' failure, with the actual exception and stack trace discarded, instead of pointing at the real defect.
recommendation: Let the exception propagate (test helpers should fail loudly), or catch only the specific expected type (e.g. FormatException from jsonDecode) and rethrow anything else.
acceptance_criteria: _loadMilestones no longer has a bare `catch (_)`; either no catch, or a narrowly-typed catch that rethrows for unexpected exceptions
